1160 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception in the Gregorian calendar rules).  
09-01-1160 is September 1, 1160.  
Subtract 57 days:  
Back up 31 days → August 1, 1160 (31 days in August).  
From August 1, subtract remaining 26 days → July has 31 days, so July 6, 1160.
